minutes.headline: Council on Aging reappointed three members and kept its chair and vice chair, meeting remotely during COVID-19.
minutes.summary: A remote Council on Aging meeting held by roll-call votes. Members approved the prior minutes, reappointed three members, and re-elected the chair and vice chair for FY21. Orientation and bylaws items were tabled until an in-person meeting. The director reported on COVID-19 operations and programs, and a van driver's resignation was read.

what_happened.line: The Council on Aging reappointed three members by roll-call vote at a remote meeting.
The same chairperson and vice chairperson were re-elected for fiscal year 21.
New-member orientation and the bylaws, policies and procedures items were tabled until the board can meet in person.
The director said Elder Affairs allowed the remaining formula grant to buy food for drive-up events, with a purchase order placed for grocery gift cards.
The kitchen renovation is on hold amid budget uncertainty; three quotes were gathered for dishwasher equipment under a Green Communities grant.

why_it_matters: Grant money for senior food and energy-efficient kitchen equipment is paying for services now, while the kitchen renovation waits on the town budget, mostly taxes.
The bylaws and policies that govern the Council on Aging stay unchanged until members can meet in person.
watch_next: The next meeting is expected in person on the 21st of next month, when the tabled orientation and bylaws items may return.
